title: Ferry 3DEP generic WGS 84 to EPSG:26910 horizontal operation lock
scope: Only normalized OSM-style [longitude, latitude] degree data to the locked GeoTIFF's EPSG:26910 [easting, northing] metres. EPSG:4326's official CRS axis order remains [latitude, longitude]; this lock's data-order normalization is explicit below. This does not create a terrain artifact and makes no vertical-datum claim.

metadataLimits.nad83Realization: not specified by the GeoTIFF GeoKeys, USGS product XML, or ScienceBase item
metadataLimits.coordinateEpoch: not specified by the GeoTIFF GeoKeys, USGS product XML, or ScienceBase item
metadataLimits.wgs84RealizationOrEpochForOsmCoordinates: not specified by the repository's WGS84/OSM coordinate inputs

target.name: NAD83 / UTM zone 10N

areaOfUse.name: North America - 126°W to 120°W and NAD83 by country

target.nad83Realization: not claimed; EPSG:26910 is generic NAD83

areaOfUse.name: North America - Canada and USA (CONUS, Alaska mainland)

operation.combinedName: Inverse of NAD83 to WGS 84 (1) + UTM zone 10N
operation.pipelineNote: The EPSG:1188 inverse has zero translations. These normalized data-order pipelines represent that generic zero-translation path and deliberately elide its no-op step; they are not a literal full EPSG axis-aware pipeline or a sub-millimetre realization claim. They accept [longitude, latitude] data and return [easting, northing] data, rather than using EPSG:4326's official [latitude, longitude] CRS axis order.

notClaimed: NAD83(HARN), NAD83(NSRS2007), NAD83(2011), or any other NAD83 realization
a coordinate epoch, including NAD83(2011) epoch 2010.00
any vertical CRS, geoid, epoch, or height transformation

rejectedCandidate.name: NAD83 to WGS 84 (43)
rejectedCandidate.reason: NGS NADCON distributes the California HPGN shift as cnhpgn.las and cnhpgn.los; PROJ packages the corresponding GeoTIFF grid as us_noaa_cnhpgn.tif. EPSG:1739 assumes NAD83(HARN) is equivalent to WGS 84. The locked USGS metadata does not identify NAD83(HARN), so selecting either grid representation would add an unsupported realization assumption.

noaa.relevance: NOAA identifies NAD83(2011) epoch 2010.00 for current CONUS surveys; that recommendation cannot be retroactively attributed to this generic-NAD83 GeoTIFF.

usgs.relevance: USGS states that 1-meter DEMs use UTM and NAD83; the locked product XML and GeoTIFF supply the more specific UTM zone and EPSG code.

proj.relevance: PROJ documents proj.db as its local SQLite database of CRS and transformation information; the verifier is dependency-free and locks the selected EPSG operation parameters explicitly.

validatedWith.currentAuthority: The current EPSG API byte receipts above, retrieved 2026-08-10, are the authority for every locked EPSG code and parameter.

tooling.receipt: The verifier emits canonical JSON (two-space indentation, LF terminator) containing the exact SHA-256 of this UTF-8 lock file and the checked forward/inverse vectors.

integrationStatus.nextDecisionForSubMetreWork: Obtain producer authority identifying the source NAD83 realization and coordinate epoch, or explicitly approve a realization-specific transformation and its grid dependencies.
